audit.title: Flags Contract Registry
audit.summary: This is a compact reference page for the Chainlink Flags Contract Registry, telling developers how to verify that a price-feed proxy is officially operated by Chainlink and listing Flags contract addresses across 21 networks. Its biggest strength is answer-first prose: the opening sentence and the two-point `true` explanation are cleanly liftable. Its biggest opportunity is machine-readability — no JSON-LD, no canonical URL, no dates — compounded by weak query coverage (no symptom-phrased headings for "how do I check if a Chainlink feed is real"). The page is factually solid but under-optimized for retrieval and agent parsing.

recommendations.title: Add symptom/intent-phrased headings for feed verification
recommendations.where: new H2/H3 sections near the top.
recommendations.issue: current headings are concept-titled ("Querying Flags Onchain") not question-shaped.
recommendations.change: add sections titled "How do I verify a Chainlink price feed is official?" and "How to check if a data feed proxy is owned by Chainlink" that answer in the first sentence with the `getFlag` call.
recommendations.why: developers/agents query by task ("is this feed legit"), not by "Flags registry"; question-shaped headings win retrieval that concept titles lose.

recommendations.title: Add JSON-LD `TechArticle` schema, canonical URL, and last-updated date
recommendations.issue: measured facts show 0 JSON-LD, canonical MISSING, no dateModified.
recommendations.change: emit `TechArticle` JSON-LD with `headline`, `dateModified`, `about: "Chainlink Data Feeds"`, and a `<link rel="canonical">`; surface a visible "Last updated" line.
recommendations.why: structured metadata and freshness signals raise parse-ability and trust for agents; the address list is time-sensitive, so a visible date matters.

recommendations.title: Add inline authoritative references
recommendations.issue: "owned and operated by Chainlink" and the `Flags` contract are unlinked.
recommendations.change: link to the Data Feeds concept page, the Flags contract source/interface on GitHub, and the AggregatorV2V3Interface reference.
recommendations.why: inline links to primary sources raise citation rate and let engines attribute claims.

recommendations.title: Make the code block canonical and complete
recommendations.issue: no `// SPDX-License-Identifier` or `pragma solidity`, no expected output.
recommendations.change: prepend `// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT` and `pragma solidity ^0.8.19;`; add a comment `// returns true if proxy is an official, active Chainlink feed`.
recommendations.why: complete, compilable snippets are lifted and reused verbatim by coding agents; the return-value comment defends the canonical semantic against paraphrase.

recommendations.title: Add a data column and a header to the address table
recommendations.issue: first column header is blank; addresses are wrapped in `<Address>` components that may not render as plain text.
recommendations.change: label the icon column (e.g., "Network"), and ensure the raw `0x…` address appears as extractable text, not only inside a component attribute.
recommendations.why: engines extract per-row facts ("Flags contract on Base = 0x…") only when address text is machine-readable in the cell.

recommendations.title: Add a short FAQ / troubleshooting block
recommendations.issue: no coverage of "getFlag returned false," "my chain isn't listed," "what if a feed is deprecated."
recommendations.change: 3–4 Q&A pairs answering those, each answer self-contained in the first sentence.
recommendations.why: symptom/error-phrased Q&A captures long-tail retrieval and gives agents debug paths.

antiPatterns: Table column with an empty header (icon-only) — hurts column-level extraction.
Addresses embedded only inside `<Address contractUrl=…>` components; plain-text `0x…` values may not survive rendering for RAG extraction.
Undated content on a page whose core payload (address list, active-feed status) is inherently time-sensitive.
offPageNotes: `llms.txt` is referenced inline (good); ensure this page's canonical URL is included there and in the sitemap.
JSON-LD/canonical/date emission is a site-template concern — fix once at the layout level to benefit all Data Feeds pages.
The CLI should pass raw `<head>` on future runs; head metadata could not be verified here, so the metadata score reflects only what was served.
